content.text: The text is an extensive alphabetical medical index covering diseases, symptoms, pathology, diagnosis, prognosis, treatment, etiology, and therapeutic remedies. Major sections address gastrointestinal and hepatic disorders, including constipation, dyspepsia, gastritis, intestinal catarrh, dysentery, enteritis, obstruction, ulcers, worms, pancreatitis, peritonitis, jaundice, cirrhosis, liver abscesses, biliary calculi, and ascites. It also covers diabetes, gout, rheumatism, rheumatoid arthritis, rachitis, scrofula, scurvy, syphilis, respiratory and pharyngeal diseases, oesophageal disorders, stomach cancer, and rectal diseases. Numerous entries cross-reference symptoms, anatomical changes, complications, diagnostic distinctions, dietary and hygienic measures, medications, enemata, baths, surgery, and historical or pathological theories. No statements describe a person entering, leaving, or traveling to a specific room or place.
